records.jp: たこ焼きって、時々無性に食べたくなりますよね。<CR>学校帰りとか、見かけるとつい買っちゃったり
records.en_original: Do you ever get takoyaki cravings? I'd sometimes just have to get some on the way home from school.
records.en_auxiliary: Do you ever get takoyaki cravings? I'd sometimes just have to get some on the way home from school.
records.en: Don't you get sudden takoyaki cravings sometimes?<CR>If I saw some on the way home from school, I'd end up buying it.

records.jp: わかる～！　でも意外。<CR>詩帆さんって買い食いとかしないと思ってた
records.en_original: Me too! That's a little surprising though. You don't strike me as an impulse buyer.
records.en_auxiliary: Me too! That's a little surprising though. You don't strike me as an impulse buyer.
records.en: I get it! But that's surprising. I didn't<CR>think you were the type to buy snacks on the way home, Shiho-san.

records.jp: 屋台を見て、思い出したんです。よく行ってた<CR>スーパーの近くに、たこ焼き屋さんがあって
records.en_original: Seeing the stall made me think of it. There was a place that sold them next to the supermarket I always went to.
records.en_auxiliary: Seeing the stall made me think of it. There was a place that sold them next to the supermarket I always went to.
records.en: Seeing the stall made me think of it. There was a place<CR>that sold them next to the supermarket I always went to.

records.jp: 前を通るたびにいい香りが……
records.en_original: Whenever I walked by, I'd be hit by the most wonderful smell...
records.en_auxiliary: Whenever I walked by, I'd be hit by the most wonderful smell...
records.en: Whenever I walked by, I'd be hit by the most wonderful smell...

records.jp: あ～
records.en_original: *sigh*
records.en_auxiliary: *sigh*
records.en: *sigh*

records.jp: でも毎回食べてたら太っちゃいますし、<CR>夕ご飯が入らなくなっちゃうので
records.en_original: But if I bought them every time I'd ruin my dinner. Not to mention the extra weight I'd gain.
records.en_auxiliary: But if I bought them every time I'd ruin my dinner. Not to mention the extra weight I'd gain.
records.en: But if I ate one every time, I'd gain weight,<CR>and I wouldn't have room for dinner.

records.jp: たまに買って、自分へのご褒美にしてたんです
records.en_original: So I only bought them occasionally. As a little reward for myself.
records.en_auxiliary: So I only bought them occasionally. As a little reward for myself.
records.en: So I only bought them occasionally. As a little reward for myself.

records.jp: えら～っ。<CR>私だったら我慢できないと思う
records.en_original: Wow, you're tough. I wouldn't be able to resist the temptation.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, you're tough. I wouldn't be able to resist the temptation.
records.en: Wow, you're tough.<CR>I wouldn't be able to resist the temptation.

records.jp: ふふ。こんな話をしてたら<CR>余計食べたくなっちゃいますね
records.en_original: Hehehe. This conversation has my tummy rumbling.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe. This conversation has my tummy rumbling.
records.en: Hehehe. This conversation<CR>has my tummy rumbling.

records.jp: 我慢は身体によくないよ
records.en_original: You know, they say that too much self-control is a bad thing.
records.en_auxiliary: You know, they say that too much self-control is a bad thing.
records.en: Holding yourself back is bad for your health.

records.jp: そうですね。食べちゃいましょう
records.en_original: I agree. Let's have some.
records.en_auxiliary: I agree. Let's have some.
records.en: I agree. Let's have some.

records.jp: あれ？<CR>もうちょっと躊躇するのかなと思ってたけど
records.en_original: Huh? I thought I was gonna get a little more push back for that.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? I thought I was gonna get a little more push back for that.
records.en: Huh?<CR>I thought you would hesitate a little more.

records.jp: わたし、料理班ですから。<CR>調整すればいいんです
records.en_original: I'm the cook, remember? I'll just adjust our diet a little bit to make up for it.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm the cook, remember? I'll just adjust our diet a little bit to make up for it.
records.en: I'm the cook, remember? I'll just adjust our<CR>diet a little bit to make up for it.

records.jp: 詩帆さん、お主も悪よのう
records.en_original: Oh Shiho, you're bad!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh Shiho, you're bad!
records.en: Shiho-san, you're quite the schemer yourself.

records.jp: 二人で分ける？
records.en_original: Wanna split some?
records.en_auxiliary: Wanna split some?
records.en: Wanna split some?

records.jp: ……二分の一なら、<CR>そんなにカロリーないですよね？
records.en_original: If we're sharing it, it can't be too bad calorie-wise, can it?
records.en_auxiliary: If we're sharing it, it can't be too bad calorie-wise, can it?
records.en: If we're sharing it, it<CR>can't be too bad calorie-wise, can it?

records.jp: ないない
records.en_original: Not bad at all!
records.en_auxiliary: Not bad at all!
records.en: Not bad at all!

records.jp: 星崎さんは何の具が好きですか？
records.en_original: What kind of filling do you like, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of filling do you like, Ao?
records.en: What kind of filling do you like, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: ソーセージかな
records.en_original: Gotta go with sausage.
records.en_auxiliary: Gotta go with sausage.
records.en: Sausage, I think.

records.jp: わかります！　プリっとした食感とか燻製の香りが<CR>生地に合うんですよね
records.en_original: I agree! It's nice and juicy, with just the right amount of smokiness. It's a perfect contrast to the breading.
records.en_auxiliary: I agree! It's nice and juicy, with just the right amount of smokiness. It's a perfect contrast to the breading.
records.en: I understand! The plump texture and smoky aroma<CR>go wonderfully with the batter.

records.jp: 今日はわたしたちしかいませんし、<CR>ソーセージだけで作っちゃいます？
records.en_original: It's just us today, shall we make them all with sausage?
records.en_auxiliary: It's just us today, shall we make them all with sausage?
records.en: It's just the two of us today,<CR>so shall we make them all with sausage?

records.jp: さんせ～い
records.en_original: Definitely!
records.en_auxiliary: Definitely!
records.en: Definitely!

records.jp: え、たこ以外にあるの？
records.en_original: Wait, there's fillings other than octopus?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, there's fillings other than octopus?
records.en: Wait, there's fillings other than octopus?

records.jp: お家で作る時、たこの代わりに<CR>好きな具材を入れたりしませんでした？
records.en_original: Do you not switch out the octopus for other things when you make it yourself?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you not switch out the octopus for other things when you make it yourself?
records.en: Don't you swap out the octopus<CR>for other fillings when you make it yourself?

records.jp: 作るより買って食べることの方が多いからなぁ
records.en_original: I guess I usually just buy them.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I usually just buy them.
records.en: I guess I usually just buy them.

records.jp: ……ソーセージ、大丈夫ですか？
records.en_original: Would you mind if I make some with sausage?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you mind if I make some with sausage?
records.en: Would you mind if I make some with sausage?

records.jp: ふつーに好きだけど
records.en_original: I do like sausage...
records.en_auxiliary: I do like sausage...
records.en: I do like sausage...

records.jp: なら、半分ソーセージ入りにするんで、<CR>騙されたと思って食べてみてください
records.en_original: In that case, I'll make half of them with sausage. I'm sure you'll like it.
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, I'll make half of them with sausage. I'm sure you'll like it.
records.en: Then I'll fill half of them with sausage,<CR>so trust me and give them a try.

records.jp: ……んんっ、うまっ！<CR>ソーセージもだけど、生地も美味しい！
records.en_original: ...Mmmmm! This is great! Both the sausage and the breading are incredible!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Mmmmm! This is great! Both the sausage and the breading are incredible!
records.en: ...Mmm, delicious!<CR>The sausage is good, but so is the batter!

records.jp: ふふふ。試行錯誤を重ねて見つけ出した、<CR>黄金レシピで作りました
records.en_original: Hehehe. It took some trial and error, but I'm quite proud of this recipe.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe. It took some trial and error, but I'm quite proud of this recipe.
records.en: Hehehe. It took some trial and error, but I'm<CR>quite proud of this recipe.

records.jp: 詩帆さんって……
records.en_original: Hey, Shiho...
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Shiho...
records.en: Hey, Shiho-san...

records.jp: 何でも作れるんだね
records.en_original: You can really cook anything, can't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You can really cook anything, can't you?
records.en: You can really cook anything, can't you?

records.jp: そんなことないですよ。<CR>挑戦したことない料理だって沢山ありますし
records.en_original: That's not true. There are still so many recipes I've yet to try.
records.en_auxiliary: That's not true. There are still so many recipes I've yet to try.
records.en: That's not true.<CR>There are still plenty of dishes I've never tried making.

records.jp: こういうアレンジも加えたら、毎日違う料理を作っても<CR>制覇できないと思います
records.en_original: If you include stuff like this I could probably cook something new every day for the rest of my life and still not have mastered everything.
records.en_auxiliary: If you include stuff like this I could probably cook something new every day for the rest of my life and still not have mastered everything.
records.en: Once you include variations like these, I don't think I could master them all<CR>even if I made a different dish every day.

records.jp: 好みも人それぞれですし。<CR>だからこそ料理って楽しいのかもしれないですけど
records.en_original: Besides, everyone has their own unique tastes. That's one of my favorite parts of cooking.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, everyone has their own unique tastes. That's one of my favorite parts of cooking.
records.en: Besides, everyone has their own<CR>unique tastes. That's one of my favorite parts of cooking.

records.jp: （こんな人にご飯を作ってもらってるなんて、<CR>幸せ者だったんだな、私）
records.en_original: (Wow. I may be the luckiest person in the world to be able to have someone like this cook for me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wow. I may be the luckiest person in the world to be able to have someone like this cook for me.)
records.en: (Wow. I may be the luckiest person in the world to be able to<CR>have someone like this cook for me.)

records.jp: 実は関西出身？
records.en_original: You're so good at making takoyaki, are you from the Kansai region or something?
records.en_auxiliary: You're so good at making takoyaki, are you from the Kansai region or something?
records.en: You're so good at making takoyaki, are you from the Kansai region or something?

records.jp: 出身は違いますが、近いところにいたことがあって
records.en_original: I was born somewhere else, but I did live there for a time.
records.en_auxiliary: I was born somewhere else, but I did live there for a time.
records.en: I was born somewhere else, but I did live there for a time.

records.jp: 学校の寮でもよくタコパしてたから、<CR>それで慣れているのかもしれません
records.en_original: I think I got used to making takoyaki at get-togethers we had at my dorm there.
records.en_auxiliary: I think I got used to making takoyaki at get-togethers we had at my dorm there.
records.en: We used to have takoyaki parties at the school dorm all the time,<CR>so that's probably why I'm used to making them.

records.jp: あ、そうだ！　今度、タコパしましょうよ！<CR>好きな具材とか、ソースを持ち寄って
records.en_original: Oh, we should do that some time! Everyone can bring their own favorite filling and sauce.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, we should do that some time! Everyone can bring their own favorite filling and sauce.
records.en: Oh, we should do that some time! Everyone can bring<CR>their own favorite filling and sauce.

records.jp: うんうん、やろうよ！　楽しそう！
records.en_original: Let's do it! That would be awesome!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's do it! That would be awesome!
records.en: Let's do it! That would be awesome!

records.jp: あればホットケーキミックスで<CR>ベビーカステラも作りたいですし、それに……
records.en_original: We can make little cakes from the batter, too! And then...
records.en_auxiliary: We can make little cakes from the batter, too! And then...
records.en: If we have pancake mix, I'd like to make<CR>baby castella too, and then...

records.jp: （すごい、アイデアがどんどん出てくる。<CR>本当に料理のことを考えるのが好きなんだな）
records.en_original: (Someone is full of ideas. She really loves cooking.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Someone is full of ideas. She really loves cooking.)
records.en: (Someone is full of ideas.<CR>She really loves cooking.)
